NC is hand-authored illustration of top-face moves, not generated from the feature map. Side holes and complete pocket clearing are not programmed.

Unsupported input rejects the entire program: canned cycles, CYCLE800, rotary axes, R arcs, compensation, macros and subprograms. This demo does not implement them.
Arc chord tolerance: 0.02 mm. Playback follows polyline distance, not feed or real machining time. Tool choices are illustrative, never production approval.
